title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1977-03-19
lineage: DAT (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC

ai_review.summary: An exceptional sound‑board recording that captures a standout Winterland show from ’77, delivering crystal‑clear audio and a fan‑favorite performance.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers hail this Miller‑sourced tape as a true gem, praising the immaculate sound quality that reflects recent archival improvements.  The Winterland run is described as one of the highlights of the 1977 trifecta, making it a must‑hear for Deadheads despite the lack of specific song commentary.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are five‑star and focus on superb audio quality and an outstanding show, yielding a near‑perfect combined rating; confidence is medium due to the small number of reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers emphasize newly discovered/improved boards with crisp, pristine sound and virtually no flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The Winterland set is praised as a centerpiece of the ’77 trifecta, indicating a tight, high‑energy performance that flows seamlessly.
